prova:
use 1
refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
filter_upwards [Ici_mem_atTop 3] with n hn
intro ⟨G, hG⟩
have h_pos : (1 : ℝ) * Real.log n ^ 3 / Real.log (Real.log n) > 0 := by
  have : 1 < Real.log n := by
    apply (one_lt_log_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    norm_cast
    omega
  positivity
have h_ge : 3 ≤ n := hn
have h_log_gt : 1 < Real.log (Real.log n) := by
  apply (one_lt_log_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
  apply (one_lt_log_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
  norm_cast
  omega
exact not_le.mpr (by positivity) (Nat.cast_le.mpr (by
  have := hG.mono (Nat.le_refl _)
  exact le_of_lt (Nat.cast_lt.mp (by
    have h_card := Finset.card_univ (α := Fin n)
    exact_mod_cast h_card.le))))
